title: pterocarpus marginatus
intro: Pterocarpus marginatus, commonly known as Mozambican copal or African copal tree, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Pterocarpus marginatus include antioxidant, antihistamine, and anti-diarrheal properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and alleviate allergic reactions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
